**Lamina 0.4.0 is out!** 🎉

This one is easier to start with: help on every setting, clearer names, and a tour of the page. And your 3D printer
is now a real machine in Lamina, not only for prototypes.

New too: **band lattice**, **paper lanterns**, **masks** and **light**.

Everything new, with pictures: *help* → *What is new*.

Try it: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/app/?ref=discord-0.4.0>
